did: A cards essay is now an authority. Each spoken line can name the code it describes, a file and lines or a quoted phrase read at the essay's stamp, and cards-check refuses a source that doesn't hold while noting a scene that cites nothing. A new cards-stale command lists the lines whose source has changed since, so a stale essay is found rather than believed, and the cards routine says to write from the code and to say what applies on home. I tested it on the home-deploy essay's runs-as-root line against the server's code. It landed in bucket 3 after two fresh reviews, and their findings were fixed.

calls.title: Which lines of an essay owe a source (C982)
options: A scene's narration owes one; the intro and close may carry one
Every line said owes one, chapter lines included
Only the lines the author marks as claims
calls.why: The narration is where each scene teaches, so it is the claim. An intro or close may still cite a command it names, and a chapter line only orients.
calls.undo: Change which lines are owed in packages/video-render/src/claims.ts.

calls.title: A wrong source refuses an essay, a missing one is noted (C983)
options: Refuse a wrong source, note a missing one
Refuse a missing source too, from a new series version on
calls.why: Essays already served are never rewritten, so refusing uncited ones would block the folder. The essays being published must have every cited commit read.
calls.undo: Move the unsourced note to a refusal in claims.ts, gated on the essay's series version.

calls.title: When a cited line counts as stale (C984)
options: The cited text is no longer anywhere in the file
The cited lines changed at the same line numbers
The file changed at all since the stamp
calls.why: A passage that only moved still says the same thing, and a file edited elsewhere shouldn't flag every essay that cites it.
calls.undo: Change the comparison in staleClaims in claims.ts.

calls.title: A quote holds at least eight characters (C985)
options: At least one whole word, matched on word boundaries
calls.why: A one-letter quote is found in every file and proves nothing, while too long a minimum makes a citation fragile.

left: Letting a cards essay's video go after its YouTube link (#2999) waits on home: the server must let a cards essay go and write its receipt before My data can offer it, or the phone would offer a delete home refuses.
A bars chart card's numbers aren't checked yet; #3406 gives them the same sources.
Home's render image must be rebuilt from main before any essay that cites sources is published, or home refuses it.
The command-line wiring for cards-check and cards-stale was checked by hand and has no tests.
